newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-MAVERICKS, ROCKETS TO PLAY REGULAR SEASON GAME IN MEXICO.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-MAVERICKS, ROCKETS TO PLAY REGULAR SEASON GAME IN MEXICO.

text.p: The Dallas Mavericks and Houston Rockets will play in the first NBA regular season game to be held in Mexico next season, the league announced on Wednesday.
The game, which will be considered a Dallas home game, will be held in Mexico City's Palacio de Deportes on December 6, 1997.
Japan is the only country outside the United States and Canada to host a regular season game.
The NBA became the first U.S. professional sports league to stage a regular season game overseas when the Phoenix Suns and Utah Jazz opened the 1990-91 season with two games in Tokyo.
